5. Arrange the products given below in the order of the reactions as
(i) Neutralization of $\text{CO}_2$ by caustic soda.
(ii) Combination of $\text{CO}_2$ and water in the presence of sunlight.
(iii) Reaction of $\text{CO}_2$ with $\text{Cl}_2$ gas.
(iv) Oxidation of Carbon by $\text{CO}_2$.
(v) CO is passed through blood.
(A) Lower oxide of carbon (B) Carbohydrate
(C) Carbonate of sodium (D) Carboxy haemoglobin
(E) Phosgene
(a) CBEDA (b) CBEAD
(c) DCBAE (d) DEBAC

6. Two substances $x$ and $y$ are taken in two test tubes and heated. The gas com-
ing out of only $y$ when passed through lime water turns it milky. Identify $x$
and $y$.
(a) $\mathrm{ZnCO}_3$ and $\mathrm{MgCO}_3$ (b) $\mathrm{KHCO}_3$ and $\mathrm{MgCO}_3$
(c) $\mathrm{K}_2\mathrm{CO}_3$ and $\mathrm{ZnCO}_3$ (d) $\mathrm{Na}_2\mathrm{CO}_3$ and $\mathrm{K}_2\mathrm{CO}_3$

7. Under normal conditions, $\mathrm{CO}_2$ is sparingly soluble in water. In which of the
following uses of $\mathrm{CO}_2$, is the above property exploited?
(a) Preparation of soft drinks
(b) Preservation of food
(c) Usage of mortar to join bricks
(d) Survival of aquatic plants

8. A fire extinguisher has been used for putting off petrol fire. It involves the
principle of neutralization. Identify the extinguisher.
(a) Dry powder extinguisher
(b) Foam-type extinguisher
(c) Liquid $\text{CO}_2$ extinguisher
(d) Soda-acid extinguisher

9. In which application are both layer lattice structure and high melting point
of graphite exploited?
(a) Refractory crucibles (b) Lubricant in machines
(c) Reinforced plastics (d) Moderator in nuclear reactor

10. Which of the following reactions involve both precipitation as well as release
of a gaseous product?
(a) Action of HCl on sodium bicarbonate
(b) Action of HCl on magnesium bicarbonate
(c) Action of HCl on sodium carbonate
(d) Action of HCl on sodium hydroxide
